name: unit_testing
description: Runs unit and integration tests for a set of changed files. Discovers the test framework from project config, executes the relevant suite, and returns structured results including pass/fail/skip counts, coverage delta, and any new failures introduced by the change.

inputs.name: changed_files
inputs.description: List of changed file paths to target.

inputs.name: framework
inputs.description: Test framework override. Auto-detected from project config if absent.

outputs.name: test_results
outputs.description: { total, passed, failed, skipped, errors, coverage_delta_percent, failed_tests: [{suite, test, message}], new_failures: int, duration_ms }

side_effects: Caches test results per changed_files hash; invalidated when files change (Law 8)

error_codes.message: Could not detect a supported test framework.
error_codes.recovery: Return an empty result with framework=unknown; do not guess (Law 12).
Return partial results so far; flag timeout.

error_codes.message: No test files matched the changed files.
error_codes.recovery: Return empty result; not an error (coverage gap report is optional).

examples: changed_files=[src/auth.rs] -> test_results with passed=12, failed=0, coverage_delta=+2.3%
